# Vinita Silaparasetty

> AI governance engineer, Apress author and educator. I design AI and data science courses, training programs and technical content for EdTech platforms, technical publishers and companies that train their own teams. Remote, across Europe. I am also the founder of Aevoxis Solutions (https://aevoxis.de), which builds tooling for EU AI Act Articles 12–14 (record-keeping, transparency, human oversight).

Credentials: Google Developer Expert (Machine Learning); AWS Community Builder (Machine Learning); M.Sc. Data Science, Newcastle University; IEEE and Elsevier invited peer reviewer; Indian Design Patent IN 307907 (dual-purpose lightweight VR headset); Best Paper Award for a paper comparing Python and R for machine learning; 14 accredited courses on the Coursera Project Network; more than 100 professionals taught in the UK and India.

Contact: info@aevoxis.de, +49 15679 836401. Projects are invoiced through SMartDe eG, a cooperative for self-employed professionals in Germany.
